_source: Miljøstyrelsen, 'Datateknisk anvisning for regnbetingede udledninger (RBU)', TA nr. DP02, version 4, gyldig fra 1. januar 2024, table 2 (side 8). https://mst.dk/media/bnkdidho/dta-dp02-rbu-version-4-2024.pdf
_note: Decodes the 'bgv_type' attribute on vp3_basis_2019_punkt_rbu_udl. Codes marked inferred:true are NOT in the dTA table - they belong to the separate-sewer stormwater outlet list and are our best reading. Verify before relying on them.

OV.en: Combined sewer overflow structure, no basin

OS.en: CSO structure with a detention basin that drains back to the treatment plant

OF.en: CSO structure with a retention basin on the overflow

OK.en: Overflow with combined detention and retention basin

Bypass.da: Overløb inde på renseanlægget som ikke indgår i renseanlæggets afløbsmålinger
Bypass.en: Bypass inside the treatment plant, outside its effluent metering

Skybrud.da: Skybrudstunnel til regn- og overløbsvand i forbindelse med skybrud
Skybrud.en: Cloudburst tunnel for stormwater and overflow water

rbu_fields.pkt_navn: Structure identifier used by the utility (e.g. UØ124).
rbu_fields.vol_sb: Sparebassin volume in m3. 0 or null means no attached basin.

typetal_overloebsvand_mg_per_l._source: Same dTA, Tabel 1 (side 7). Median concentrations used nationally to convert an overflow volume into a pollutant load.
